protocol: PART 0 read-only hash / confidence / emission-site audit

hash_uses.why: Object identity / dict key / determinism for immutable Detection value objects.
Signature identity; used in _node_signature_hash for sorting/dedup.
Canonical signature identity bytes; sort key / dedup, not similarity.
Detection signature hash for canonical ordering / dedup.
Canonical subgraph identity; dict key in _canonical_hash_index.
Exact retrieval by canonical hash (identity lookup).
Dedup index keyed by canonical hash (identity).
Core-library canonical key; lookup_by_hash retrieves by exact hash.
Retrieves a core entry by exact hash -- a hash-keyed retrieval that decides identity of a structural core. This is a MATCH use (retrieval by hash).
1-WL canonical hash of a subgraph used as core_hash for library lookup/retrieval. Decides structural identity by hash equality.
128-bit WL canonical hash of a typed directed subgraph; used for subgraph identity/matching.

The address string is the canonical ID (NAME: _l6_address unique-count diagnostics, dict key). But l6_eval compares addresses by exact equality (MATCH: placement agreement) and builds address histograms for classification (MATCH: cosine over histogram). The MATCH uses are the target of Part 3.
Decides placement agreement by exact address-string equality. One lost edge changes the address -> node is a stranger to itself. Primary MATCH use.
Builds a histogram over exact address strings; cosine compares histograms. Address equality decides the bin. MATCH use.
Memoization / cache keys for extracted fields; identity, not similarity.
Detection-set identity / tombstone identity; dict keys.
Deterministic ordering by canonical hash (tie-break), not similarity decision.

confidence_consumers.detail: conf_factor = min(self.confidence, other.confidence) if use_confidence else 1.0; returns base * conf_factor. Graded multiplier.
Delegates to EdgeParams.similarity; applies a specificity cap on generic relations.
Population-weighted graded similarity; confidence enters via the mixture.
Calls polymorphic_edge_similarity with use_confidence controlled by P.EDGE_MATCH_USE_CONFIDENCE. Currently the flag defaults such that confidence is graded when enabled.
Consensus confidence averaged over same-class edges; graded.
Bridges evidence fields (sign, confidence) from source edge; graded.
Fuzzy edge-param mean with confidence weighting; graded.

confidence_consumers.consumer: Binder emission sites set confidence=1.0 or clamp(signal,0,1)
confidence_consumers.detail: Most _edge_params calls hardcode confidence=1.0; a few use clamp(signal,0,1). Until Part 1a they are effectively binary, not graded.

emission_sites.role: single choke point for ALL lens/binder edge channels

hard_cutoffs.name: signal normalization
hard_cutoffs.rule: divide by the MAXIMUM candidate signal, not a high percentile

hard_cutoffs.name: corner turn
hard_cutoffs.rule: polyline turn > threshold -> corner, else not

hard_cutoffs.name: dedup radius
hard_cutoffs.rule: corners closer than radius merged (keep max turn)

emission_sites.role: computes WL addresses; NO edge emission
